scientific_integrity: The exact finite-dimensional block identity, analytic Gaussian hard-edge calculation, dependency-graph estimate, and moment majorant constitute the proof. A standalone numerical checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only complex circular Gaussian windows of variance 1/(2p), two adjacent translations, even modulations and fixed-threshold Poisson convergence. No non-Gaussian universality, point-process convergence, or maximum-eigenvalue limit.
title: A Poisson hard-edge law for a correlated Gaussian cyclic Gabor basis
